narration.plugin.name: Narration
narration.plugin.description: Generate narration audio for entries from configured fields.
narration.providers.section.title: Providers
narration.providers.tab.openai.configCom: Connection details for this provider will appear here after integration. API keys will continue to be set only via environment variables and config/plugins.ts.
narration.providers.tab.openai.demoComin: Text-to-speech testing will be available here after integration.
narration.providers.usage.section.title: Usage
narration.providers.usage.elevenlabs.bod: Open ElevenLabs to review character credits, synthesis history, and other usage analytics for your account.
narration.providers.usage.openai.body: Review API usage for your OpenAI organization. OpenAI narration support in this plugin is not live yet.
narration.setup.section.title: Connection
narration.setup.checklist.step1: In ElevenLabs, create an API key with Text to Speech and Voices → Read.
narration.setup.checklist.step2: Set ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in the environment and pass it into narration via config/plugins.ts using env(). Restart Strapi after changes.
narration.setup.checklist.step3: Confirm voices load and run the Narration test below.
narration.setup.checklist.status.keyMiss: No ElevenLabs API key detected on this server yet — finish step 2, then reload this page.
narration.setup.checklist.status.catalog: A static voice catalog is configured; listing voices may not call ElevenLabs. Real TTS still needs a server API key (step 2).
narration.setup.loadError: Could not load connection status. Open the browser network tab or Strapi server logs if this persists.
narration.customField.label: Narration
narration.customField.description: Configure sources and required default voice in Content-Type Builder; generate audio into the Media Library or attach an MP3 manually; voice and file id are stored on this field.
narration.connect.generate_section.title: Generate narration
narration.connect.manual.upload_unavaila: Media Library is unavailable (upload plugin may be disabled).
narration.connect.manual.non_audio: The selected file is not an audio type. Pick an MP3 or other audio asset.
narration.generate.need-save: Save the entry first, then generate narration.
narration.generate.ok: Narration generated. Audio is in the Media Library; file id stored on this field.
narration.voices.error: Could not load voices. Check ELEVENLABS_API_KEY and API key permissions (voices_read, text_to_speech).
narration.options.narrationSources.label: Narration sources (order)
narration.options.narrationSources.descr: Pick fields on this type and order them. Blocks vs text handling follows each field’s Strapi type automatically.
narration.options.defaultVoiceId.label: Default voice (required)
narration.options.defaultVoiceId.descrip: Required — used in the entry editor when no per-entry voice is stored yet, and as the baseline until the author picks another.
narration.options.narrationSourcePauseSe: Extra silence between each configured source in the TTS text (SSML break; 0 = off, max 3s). Depends on ElevenLabs model capabilities.
narration.options.blockTypesAllowlist.de: Comma-separated block type names to include from blocks sources (e.g. paragraph,heading,list,list-item). Leave empty for plugin defaults.
narration.options.stripDelimiterPairs.de: Add one or more start/end tag pairs. Each pair removes matching regions (including the tags) from narration text before TTS, from first match to first closing tag, repeated until none remain. Rows run in order.
narration.voice.open-to-load: Open list to load voices (no API call until then)
narration.demo.section.title: Narration test
narration.demo.section.body: Plays a short “Hello” sample with the same narration flow as the entry editor. Use it to confirm narration works before generating full posts.
narration.demo.voice.label: Voice
narration.demo.voices.error: Could not load voices. Check ELEVENLABS_API_KEY and permissions (voices_read, text_to_speech).
narration.demo.voices.empty: No voices returned. Set ELEVENLABS_API_KEY or configure a static voice catalog in plugin config.
narration.demo.dry-run: This response used placeholder audio (development mode on the server), not live billed TTS. Ask your team or check server logs if you expected real synthesis.
narration.demo.player.label: Playback
narration.demo.player.fallback: Audio not supported in this browser.
narration.audio.url-error: Could not load file URL. You can still clear the stored file id from this entry with Disconnect.
narration.audio.no-html5-audio: Your browser cannot play this audio.
narration.audio.detach-notify: Narration audio disconnected from this entry. Save to persist. The file remains in the Media Library.
